description: Ack pruning efficiency analysis computed from oracle experiment data. NOTE: 'oracle_token_overhead' reports GPT-4o oracle classifier API token usage, NOT agent message tokens. Per-task agent message token counts are not available in the source data.

oracle_token_overhead.note: These are GPT-4o oracle classifier API tokens (resp.usage.total_tokens), not agent message tokens.

oracle_cost.pricing_assumption: GPT-4o: $2.50/1M input, $10/1M output, 80/20 split → effective $4.00/1M tokens

latency.caveat: Assumes roughly uniform per-round latency; actual savings depend on message generation length and model throughput.

oracle_token_overhead.note: These are GPT-4o oracle classifier API tokens (resp.usage.total_tokens), not agent message tokens.

oracle_cost.pricing_assumption: GPT-4o: $2.50/1M input, $10/1M output, 80/20 split → effective $4.00/1M tokens

latency.caveat: Assumes roughly uniform per-round latency; actual savings depend on message generation length and model throughput.

estimated_agent_token_savings.method: Estimated using per-category mean token lengths from paper (appendix_info_theory.tex, appendix_examples.tex). Not directly measured from trace data.

qwen.note: 56.3% of messages pruned yields only 10.1% token savings because ack messages are much shorter (mean 9 tokens) than substantive messages (mean 95-117 tokens).

llama.note: Llama acks are more verbose (mean 59.8 tokens vs Qwen mean 9.0), yielding higher token savings despite lower suppression rate.

open_weight_local.scenario: Open-weight models on local GPUs (this paper's setting)
open_weight_local.primary_savings: GPU-seconds and latency from eliminated inference calls
open_weight_local.oracle_cost: GPT-4o oracle used for validation only; deployment uses heuristic detector (F1=0.845)

api_models.primary_savings: Each suppressed message = one fewer API call (includes per-call overhead, not just tokens)
api_models.note: API pricing has per-call minimums and context window costs; savings exceed pure token reduction

oracle_vs_heuristic.recommendation: Use heuristic in deployment; oracle for validation/calibration only

key_findings: Primary value: inference call reduction — Qwen 56.3%, Llama 36.9% fewer LLM calls
Estimated agent token savings are modest: Qwen ~10.1%, Llama ~27.5% (ack messages are short)
Ack pruning's value is reducing inference calls and latency, not token savings
Llama acks are more verbose (mean 59.8 tokens) than Qwen acks (mean 9.0), explaining higher token savings despite lower suppression rate
Oracle overhead: $13.90-$14.42 per 1K tasks; deployable heuristic (F1=0.845) has zero API cost
